notes: Gathered on 2026-11-18 with WebFetch (page text summarised by a small model; dates and amounts were requested as exact sentences and copied as stated) and WebSearch used only to find URLs. Every entry's source_url is a page that was fetched and read. Facts seen only in search snippets are in gaps, not entries. The yield is low because most calls on the sites named in the brief had already closed or give no closing date; the entries are open calls that are national, EU-wide or in Lisbon. No websummit.com, lu.ma, luma.com, meetup.com or eventbrite pages were fetched. Nothing here is already in open-calls.json or algarve.json. Reviewed by startups.b@PrompTugal.dinis on 18 November 2026: Founder Institute Lisbon removed (a paid commercial programme whose stated deadline is the end of an early price, not a closing date). Santander Explorer's and Rising Up in Spain's years are inferred from their articles' dates (12 November and October 2026).

entries.name: Santander Explorer, next edition (applications through Santander X)
entries.what: Free entrepreneurship programme for people with an idea or project with entrepreneurial potential, aimed at young university students and people early in their careers; no registered company needed. The UPTEC news item of 12 November 2026 states "As candidaturas estão abertas até 10 de dezembro e podem ser feitas através da plataforma Santander X." The first 2027 edition is fully online and open to entrepreneurs in 13 countries including Portugal.

entries.name: European Prize for Women Innovators 2027
entries.what: EU innovation prize with three categories: Women Innovators (women founders and co-founders from the EU and countries associated to Horizon Europe), EIT Women Leadership (members of the EIT Community) and Rising Innovators (women innovators under 35). The EIC page states applications close on "1 December 2026, 17:00 CET." EU-wide, so open to Portuguese founders; the place is set to portugal for that reason only.
entries.amount: Women Innovators EUR 100,000 / 70,000 / 50,000; EIT Women Leadership EUR 50,000 / 30,000 / 20,000; Rising Innovators EUR 50,000 / 30,000 / 20,000 (1st / 2nd / 3rd place), as stated by the EIC

entries.name: Open Innovation Amarsul|Valorsul 2026 (waste management)
entries.what: Open innovation call by the waste operators Amarsul and Valorsul for start-ups, other companies (national and international) and academia with new technologies for waste management operations. Forbes Portugal, 2 November 2026, quotes "As candidaturas estão abertas entre 2 de novembro de 2026 e 25 de janeiro de 2027" (deadline 24:00 on the closing day). Selection runs to 15 March 2027 and the pitch day is planned for the second half of April 2027. Source is a press article, not the organisers' own page.
entries.amount: Each winning project receives a prize of EUR 3,000 ("3.000 euros") and can develop a funded pilot; the programme as a whole offers more than EUR 150,000, as stated

entries.name: Rising Up in Spain (ICEX, via Invest in Spain)
entries.what: Free programme for technology start-ups and scaleups of any country that are considering Spain as an expansion market; 50 places, selected in order of application, so it can close earlier. AICEP's news item states "As candidaturas decorrem até 31 de dezembro", with 2026 given in the practical information. Run by ICEX; AICEP published the news.
